extracted.subtask_description: A practical handbook covering the fundamentals of newswriting and reporting, from composing leads through editing and specialized beats (speeches, meetings, crime, sports), and newsroom practices. Intended to teach reporters how to prepare, order, and polish copy and how to cover common news situations.
